% A test for tex8web: colors in math in a document with xcolor but not
% colortbl (which has MathJax load its color extension up front): the
% \definecolor lines MathJax is given load the extension themselves.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\definecolor{ink}{RGB}{200,0,100}
\colorlet{accent}{ink}
\begin{document}
In math, $\textcolor{accent}{a} + \textcolor{green}{b} + \textcolor[HTML]{3366CC}{c}$.
\end{document}
